k:HH.Setting.underworld.organ.orderPremi: Grim only: a ready organ delivered within the deadline pays this many times the normal price.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.organ.priceFacto: Share of the market value the anonymous buyers pay.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.pit.betMax.Desc: Guests bet at most this much silver (and never more than a third of their budget).
k:HH.Setting.underworld.pit.betMin.Desc: Guests bet at least this much silver.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.pit.fairRatio.De: The stronger fighter may have at most this many times the combat power of the weaker one.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.pit.houseCut.Des: The share of the betting pool the house keeps (totalisator).
k:HH.Setting.underworld.pit.intervalHour: A fight pit with enough fighters and spectators starts a bout this often.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.pit.maxBoutTicks: A bout nobody wins within this time is a draw: all stakes are returned.
A bout ends when a fighter drops below this share of health, unless it is to the death.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.scandalCooldownD: At most one scandal per map in this many days.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.smuggler.inspect: Per landing, if an imperial authority exists.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.smuggler.interva: Average time between night landings at a smuggler's dock.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.smuggler.maxValu: Market value of the biggest crate offered.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.smuggler.priceFa: Share of the market value you pay for a crate.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.strangerCooldown: After "Not interested" the stranger waits this many days before he asks again.
After this many refusals the stranger gives up for good.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.strangerMaxWhisp: He only turns up while your Whispers are at or below this value.
k:HH.Setting.underworld.strangerMeanDays: Days until the stranger shows up
Average number of days between the moments the stranger may come (once the colony has guests or a venue, and your Whispers are low).
k:HH.Setting.underworld.whispersDecay.De: Whispers lose this share of their value every 15 days.
k:HH.Setting.venues.autoNames.Desc: A new venue sign gets a name that fits its kind of business (for example 'The Drowsy Alpaca' for a tavern). You can always rename it or roll another one.
k:HH.Setting.venues.bellHurry.Desc: Colonists who answer the bell jog to the venue instead of walking.
k:HH.Setting.venues.bellRange.Desc: How far the bell carries for someone with normal hearing. Walls and closed doors in between shorten it; poor hearing shortens it a lot, deaf colonists never hear it.
k:HH.Setting.venues.bellResponders.Desc: How many colonists at most come running when the bell rings.
k:HH.Setting.venues.bellWakeCooldownHour: A colonist who was woken by the bell is not woken again for this many hours.
k:HH.Setting.venues.bellWakes.Desc: Off: the bell only makes a sound, colonists notice it when their work lets them. Awake only: awake colonists within hearing range hurry to the venue. Wake volunteers: also colonists who sleep and have the Serving work set to priority 1 or 2 (or with simple work settings), at most once per half a day each, with a small mood cost.
k:HH.Setting.venues.bellWho.Desc: Serving only: colonists with the Serving work type switched on. Any colonist: every colonist who is able to serve.
k:HH.Setting.venues.busyServedPerHour: Busy shift: guests served per hour
k:HH.Setting.venues.busyServedPerHour.De: A shift counts as busy (good mood) when the tender served at least this many guests per hour.
k:HH.Setting.venues.honorMessages.Desc: Show a message when a colonist saw a guest leave without paying.
k:HH.Setting.venues.honorNoPay: Honor system: chance to pay nothing
k:HH.Setting.venues.honorNoPay.Desc: At an unattended honor-system venue, the chance that a guest takes the goods without paying at all.
k:HH.Setting.venues.honorUnderpay: Honor system: chance to pay too little
k:HH.Setting.venues.honorUnderpay.Desc: At an unattended honor-system venue, the chance that a guest leaves only part of the price (30-80 %) in the box.
k:HH.Setting.venues.honorWatched: Honor system: effect of being watched
k:HH.Setting.venues.honorWatched.Desc: How much less often guests underpay while a colonist can see them (1 = never while watched).
k:HH.Setting.venues.idleHours.Desc: A tender who has served nobody for this many hours of a shift gets bored (bad mood, a little worse every further stretch).
k:HH.Setting.venues.nightBell.Desc: Guests may ring a bell for a venue that is closed. Colonists with the Serving work type who hear it come running and open the venue for a surcharge (see the night bell settings below for who is called and who may be woken).
k:HH.Setting.venues.requireSetup.Desc: A business only opens once the furniture its type needs stands in the room (a tavern needs a counter, a table and seats, a casino at least one game, and so on; see the sign's Setup tab). Off: missing furniture is only a hint.
k:HH.Setting.venues.serviceSkill.Desc: How much the Social skill of whoever is on duty matters: friendlier service, bigger purchases, tips and quicker sales. 0 = skill does not matter.
k:HH.Setting.venues.setupHints.Desc: A selected venue sign shows build buttons for the furniture its business still needs.
k:HH.Setting.venues.shiftThoughts.Desc: Colonists who tend a venue are pleased after a busy shift and bored when they stand around for hours with nothing to do.
k:HH.Setting.venues.staffRule.Desc: Per venue type: taverns, restaurants, casinos and spas need someone on duty, shops and lounges do not. Never: every venue runs as self-service. Always: every venue needs someone on duty.
k:HH.Setting.venues.tipShare.Desc: Largest tip a guest leaves on top of a purchase, as a share of the price, for a perfect tender. The chance and size of a tip grow with the tender's Social skill.
